name: Drainberry Bush
languages: can't speak any language; telepathy 100 feet

generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 120 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

generalAbilities.name: Nature Empathy
generalAbilities.description: The drainberry bush can use Diplomacy to Make an impression on and make very simple Requests of animals and plant creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Berries
offensiveAbilities.description:
The drainberry bush must drain blood from living creatures for sustenance. This causes clusters of bright red berries to grow among its branches.

Each cluster of berries lasts for 1 day, and a drainberry bush typically has 1d6+3 clusters when encountered. When consumed, a cluster restores (2d8+10) Healing Damage Hit Points. This effect has the healing, necromancy, and primal traits.

A creature can pluck a cluster of berries with a successful unarmed Strike or Thievery check against the bush's AC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Berries
offensiveAbilities.description: The bush draws nourishment from one cluster of blood berries, regaining (2d8+10) Healing Damage Hit Points. That berry cluster wrinkles and dies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Blood
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The drainberry bush has at least one living creature Grabbed with one of its vines

Effect The bush's hollow thorns siphon blood from creatures it has grabbed. Each creature must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save or take 2d8+10 damage and become Drained 1 (double damage and Drained 2 on a critical failure). For every creature damaged this way, a cluster of blood berries immediately grows along the bush's branches.

offensiveAbilities.name: Storm of Vines
offensiveAbilities.description: The drainberry bush makes up to four vine Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the bush's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the bush makes all these attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead spend an action to use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
